note: Text Summary Options adds three site-builder settings (show_summary bool, summary_help string, summary_placeholder string) to text_with_summary fields, stored as third-party settings on the FieldConfig entity at field.field.<entity>.<bundle>.<field>.third_party_settings.text_summary_options. No configure route, no settings form. Medium/hard cases are grounded in that real config on namespaced text_with_summary fields on the Article content type (field_tso_*): introspection reads back the configured help/placeholder; execution turns show_summary on / sets a placeholder, verified against the live FieldConfig. Fields are created idempotently; hard-case reset leaves the field present with the setting OFF (clean baseline), so verify fails on empty state and passes only after the agent configures it.

evals.prompt: The Drupal module text_summary_options adds options to the 'Text (formatted, long, with summary)' widget. What three settings does it add, and where are they configured?
evals.expected_output: It adds Show summary, Summary help text, and Summary Placeholder. You set them on the field's edit form (Manage fields -> edit the text_with_summary field), and they are stored as third-party settings under text_summary_options on that FieldConfig.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal 11 site with text_summary_options enabled, there is no admin settings page. Where exactly is the 'Show summary' choice stored in configuration for a given field, and what config key holds it?
evals.expected_output: It is a third-party setting on the FieldConfig entity: field.field.<entity>.<bundle>.<field> -> third_party_settings.text_summary_options.show_summary: true. Read it with $fieldConfig->getThirdPartySetting('text_summary_options','show_summary').

evals.prompt: For which field type does text_summary_options show its extra options, and what does the 'Show summary' setting actually change in the edit form?
evals.expected_output: Only for text_with_summary fields. Show summary removes the summary element's #attached (the core 'Edit summary' toggle JS) so the summary textarea is displayed expanded by default instead of hidden behind the link.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a 'Text (formatted, long, with summary)' field whose text_summary_options settings have been configured. Inspect the live field configuration and report the machine name of that field and the summary placeholder text that is set on it.
evals.expected_output: The field is field_tso_sum; its FieldConfig has third_party_settings.text_summary_options.show_summary: true and summary_placeholder: 'TSO placeholder marker one'.

evals.prompt: The Article content type on this site has a text-with-summary field named field_tso_help that has custom summary help text configured via text_summary_options. Inspect the live configuration and state the exact summary help text.
evals.expected_output: The summary_help third-party setting on field.field.node.article.field_tso_help under text_summary_options is 'TSO help marker two text'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a text-with-summary field field_tso_show. Using the text_summary_options module, configure that field so its summary is shown by default (Show summary enabled). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: On field.field.node.article.field_tso_show set third_party_settings.text_summary_options.show_summary to TRUE (e.g. $fc->setThirdPartySetting('text_summary_options','show_summary',TRUE); $fc->save(); or tick 'Show summary' on the field edit form).

evals.prompt: The Article content type on this site has a text-with-summary field field_tso_ph. Use the text_summary_options module to add placeholder text to that field's summary box, and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: On field.field.node.article.field_tso_ph set a non-empty third_party_settings.text_summary_options.summary_placeholder (e.g. $fc->setThirdPartySetting('text_summary_options','summary_placeholder','Enter a short teaser'); $fc->save()).
